offence_note: Sexual assault of daughter; long-term offender application
sentence_quote: on Count 1 of the indictment, the offence of sexual assault, I sentence you to three years and 11 months imprisonment, in addition to the time you have already served.
note: Seven years less 3y1m credit; mitigating was lack of physical violence; also LTSO 10 years.

offence_note: Three robberies and committing offence while masked
sentence_quote: The judge imposed a conditional sentence of two years less a day for each of the offences, all to be served concurrently.
note: Crown leave granted, appeal dismissed; conditional sentence stands. Probation not shown.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, kicked victim in head
sentence_quote: The sentence I impose upon you is three years, two months. You will be given credit for one year, two months, arising from the 278 days you have been in custody to date
note: Joint submission; victim surcharge waived; recommended Nanaimo Correctional Centre (ordinary jail).

sentence_quote: I would therefore grant leave, allow the appeal of the nine-month term, and substitute a sentence of time served.
systemic_quote: The sentencing judge's failure to consider s. 718.2(e) was, in my view, an error
note: Nine months reduced to time served; three-year probation with treatment left intact.

offence_note: Importing heroin and possession for trafficking
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to: (i) six years' imprisonment for importing; and (ii) a concurrent term of six years' imprisonment for possession for the purpose of trafficking.
note: Conviction appeal dismissed; leave to appeal sentence granted, appeal dismissed.

offence_note: Break and enter and sexual assault of 13-year-old cousin
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal and substitute a custodial sentence of two years for the three-year sentence imposed by the judge. The appellant should receive credit of 358 days for pre-sentence custody.
systemic_quote: given the systemic issues to be addressed, the appellant's status as a first-time offender, the nature of the offence and the appellant's family circumstances, these factors must be taken into account to arrive at an appropriate sentence.
note: Three-year probation continues; ancillary orders not shown. Sentence reduced from three years.

sentence_quote: a fit and proportionate sentence on Count 1 is one of four years in a federal penitentiary, and 18 months on Count 3.
note: Concurrent sentences; Count 2 stayed; s.161 order for 10 years.

offence_note: Sexual interference and sexual and physical violence against 12-14 year old
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed sentences totalling 8 years.
note: Sentence appeal allowed only for 158 days credit (105 days at 1.5:1); sentence otherwise stands.
